fund_name.value: Calder & Wyeth Private Credit Fund III, L.P.
fund_name.quote: Calder & Wyeth Private Credit Fund III, L.P. (the "Fund") is a closed-end, drawdown private investment fund organized as a limited partnership under the laws of the State of Delaware on November 3, 2024.

fund_domicile.quote: Calder & Wyeth Private Credit Fund III, L.P. (the "Fund") is a closed-end, drawdown private investment fund organized as a limited partnership under the laws of the State of Delaware on November 3, 2024.

fund_structure.quote: Calder & Wyeth Private Credit Fund III, L.P. (the "Fund") is a closed-end, drawdown private investment fund organized as a limited partnership under the laws of the State of Delaware on November 3, 2024.

management_fee.value: 1.50% annually of each Limited Partner's aggregate capital commitment during the Investment Period, and 1.50% annually of each Limited Partner's invested capital in unrealized portfolio investments after the Investment Period
management_fee.quote: The Fund pays the Investment Adviser a management fee (the "Management Fee") payable quarterly in advance. During the Investment Period, the Management Fee is charged at an annual rate of 1.50% of each Limited Partner's aggregate capital commitment, whether or not drawn. Following expiration or termination of the Investment Period, the Management Fee is charged at an annual rate of 1.50% of each Limited Partner's invested capital in unrealized portfolio investments, determined at cost and reduced as investments are realized or written off.

performance_fee.value: 20% of profits after the preferred return and catch-up
performance_fee.citation: Article VI — DISTRIBUTIONS AND CARRIED INTEREST, 6.1
performance_fee.quote: The General Partner's share of distributions under the Third and Fourth tiers constitutes the "Carried Interest." The Carried Interest is 20% of profits, subject to the 7% preferred return and the 80/20 catch-up described above.

hurdle_rate.citation: Article VI — DISTRIBUTIONS AND CARRIED INTEREST, 6.1
hurdle_rate.quote: Second — Preferred Return. 100% to the Limited Partners until each Limited Partner has received a cumulative preferred return of 7% per annum, compounded annually, on the amounts described in the First tier.

high_water_mark.citation: Article VI — DISTRIBUTIONS AND CARRIED INTEREST, 6.1
high_water_mark.quote: There is no high water mark. A high water mark is a feature of open-end funds that charge a periodic performance allocation on unrealized appreciation; the Fund charges Carried Interest only on realized distributions through the waterfall described above.

minimum_initial_investment.citation: Article II — TARGET SIZE AND COMMITMENTS, 2.2
minimum_initial_investment.quote: The minimum capital commitment for a Limited Partner is $10,000,000.

lockup_period.citation: Article IV — TERM AND INVESTMENT PERIOD, 4.4
lockup_period.quote: The Fund does not offer redemption or withdrawal rights of any kind. There is no lock-up period as that term is used in open-end funds, because there is no mechanism by which a Limited Partner may redeem.

redemption_frequency.citation: Article IV — TERM AND INVESTMENT PERIOD, 4.4
redemption_frequency.quote: The Fund does not offer redemption or withdrawal rights of any kind. There is no redemption frequency, because no redemptions are permitted.

redemption_notice_days.citation: Article IV — TERM AND INVESTMENT PERIOD, 4.4
redemption_notice_days.quote: The Fund does not offer redemption or withdrawal rights of any kind. There is no redemption notice period, because no redemptions are permitted.

gate_provision.citation: Article IV — TERM AND INVESTMENT PERIOD, 4.4
gate_provision.quote: The Fund does not offer redemption or withdrawal rights of any kind. There is no gate provision, because no redemptions are permitted.

key_man_provision.value: If both Rosalind Adeyemi-Clarke and Theodore Vance Kirkpatrick, or any three of the four members of the investment committee, cease to devote substantially all of their business time to the affairs of the Sponsor and the Fund during the Investment Period, the Investment Period is automatically suspended.
key_man_provision.citation: Article VII — MANAGEMENT AND KEY PERSON PROVISION, 7.2
key_man_provision.quote: A "Key Person Event" occurs if both Rosalind Adeyemi-Clarke and Theodore Vance Kirkpatrick, or any three (3) of the four (4) members of the investment committee, cease to devote substantially all of their business time to the affairs of the Sponsor and the Fund during the Investment Period.

gp_commitment.value: 2.0% of aggregate commitments, subject to a minimum of $20,000,000 and a maximum of $30,000,000
gp_commitment.citation: Article VII — MANAGEMENT AND KEY PERSON PROVISION, 7.3
gp_commitment.quote: The General Partner, together with the Sponsor, its principals, employees and their respective affiliates and estate planning vehicles, shall make an aggregate capital commitment to the Fund of not less than 2.0% of aggregate commitments, subject to a minimum of $20,000,000 and a maximum of $30,000,000.

fund_term.value: 8 years from the final closing date, extendable for up to 2 consecutive one-year periods, for a maximum term of 10 years
fund_term.citation: Article IV — TERM AND INVESTMENT PERIOD, 4.2
fund_term.quote: The Fund shall continue until the eighth (8th) anniversary of the final closing date (the "Initial Term"). The General Partner may extend the Initial Term for up to two (2) consecutive one-year periods, the first with the consent of the Advisory Committee and the second with the consent of Limited Partners holding a majority in interest of aggregate commitments. Accordingly, the maximum term of the Fund is ten (10) years from the final closing date, subject to a further extension solely for the purpose of winding up, which shall not exceed twelve (12) months.

auditor.quote: Halloran Meade & Co. LLP has been engaged as the Fund's independent registered public accounting firm.

administrator.quote: Pemberton Vaux Fund Administration LLC serves as the administrator to the Fund, responsible for capital account maintenance, capital call and distribution processing, and preparation of quarterly investor statements.

prime_broker.quote: The Fund has not appointed a prime broker. The Fund does not engage in short selling, securities lending or margin trading, and accordingly no prime brokerage relationship is required.

legal_counsel.quote: Ashford Petrakis & Lowe LLP serves as counsel to the Fund, the General Partner and the Sponsor.

mfn_election.citation: Article X — TRANSFERS AND SIDE LETTERS, 10.3
mfn_election.quote: The Fund provides a most favored nation ("MFN") election. Within sixty (60) days following the final closing, the General Partner shall deliver to each Limited Partner a schedule summarizing the material terms granted in all side letters.
